title: user_sessions
description: Server-side session behind the httpOnly cookie (UA-13/UA-14). The token exists only in the cookie; this row holds sha256(token) (tokenHash, globally unique) and never the token. Scopes are NOT stored here: they are derived from the user's role on every request, so a role change applies at once. There is no absolute expiry; idle expiry (365 d since lastUsedAt) is evaluated by the API. Rotation keeps the previous hash for a 30 s grace (previousTokenHash/previousValidUntil) and the last 5 retired hashes (retiredTokenHashes) so a replayed old token is recognised as reuse and the whole familyId is revoked. A revoked or expired row carries revokedAt + revokedReason + purgeAt (30 days later) all together; an ACTIVE row carries none of the three, so Mongo's TTL index never removes it. purgeAt is a BSON Date (TTL indexes ignore every other type); JSON fixtures show it as an ISO string. ipPrefix is a truncated /24 or /48, userAgentSummary a coarse 'browser family + OS' - never the full address or raw User-Agent.

tenantId.description: The user's tenant; A3 checks it equals the user row's tenant on every lookup (UA-27).

familyId.description: Constant across rotations; reuse detection revokes the whole family.

purgeAt.description: BSON Date, set with revokedAt (revoke time + 30 days); drives the TTL index.
